Application Process | High School Students | U.S. Air Force ROTC
HIGH SCHOOL SCHOLARSHIP APPLICATION PROCESS
STEP 01

Verify eligibility and you are applying for the correct academic year/cycle.

The high school scholarship program is now open. You MUST DOWNLOAD AND  READ THE APPLICATION GUIDE to confirm eligibility for the 2027 school year. Prospective applicants must intend to enroll college and enter the AFROTC program beginning in the 2027-2028 academic year. The scholarship application window will be open July 1, 2026, through December 11, 2026. Completion of your junior year of high school is required for all ROTC applications. Please do not start an application before that.
